title: UniRelight Joint Video Decomposition and Synthesis Framework
summary: Developed by NVIDIA, UniRelight is a single-pass video relighting framework that jointly performs intrinsic decomposition and synthesis. It utilizes the 7B-parameter Cosmos-Predict1 foundation model to achieve high fidelity and temporal consistency in complex lighting scenarios.
research_notes: Uses NVIDIA OneWay Noncommercial License; requires Cosmos-Predict1 backbone weights and Hugging Face access.

evolution.summary: Following its NeurIPS 2025 presentation, the code and weights were released in April 2026. It represents a shift to single-pass joint modeling using the NVIDIA Cosmos backbone, significantly outperforming previous multi-stage relighting pipelines.
